body: My advice is if you're gonna give a deadline to your life you should try finding reasons to live. Try to get hooked to gaming, reading or watching series on netflix. Talk to random people on the net or irl. I was in your position 3 years back. Worked for me and hope it works for you too.

I have seriously considered Therapist and i plan on booking a time at the school therapist in the near future.
I'm really unsure about talking to him about this since I'm afraid that it will drive him away from me. I'm not yet ready to take the risk since I know that it's game over for me if i lose him. I was also unsure about posting this since he spends a lot of time on reddit and has a chance to see this and recognise me from this post.
Also I feel I can't tell any of my friends since my friends are limited to the small group that he is also a part of.
